headline_item.title_en: United Airlines says it will prevent personal AI assistants from booking tickets, citing data privacy risks and possible FAA and DOT rule violations (Alison Sider/Wall Street Journal)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 美联航宣布禁止个人AI助手代订机票，理由是存在隐私风险及违反监管条例
headline_item.event_summary_en: United Airlines has announced it will block personal AI agents from booking tickets to mitigate data privacy risks and avoid compliance issues with FAA and DOT regulations. The carrier intends to cut off third-party AI tools from scraping or manipulating its proprietary booking systems.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美联航在航空订票系统场景：禁止个人AI助手进行订票操作
【起因与机理】担忧数据隐私安全及违反联邦监管规则
【关键技术规格】全面封杀个人AI购票行为。
【观点态度】以合规与隐私为由维护商业利益。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] United Airlines (Airline booking ecosystem): Banning personal AI agents from ticket booking
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Concerns over data privacy and federal regulatory compliance
[Key Specification] United Airlines tightens API controls.
[Perspective & Impact] Leveraging compliance/privacy to protect revenue.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 航司这哪是担心什么隐私风险，分明是怕AI太聪明，不仅看穿了动态定价的套路，还把那些隐藏的联程BUG票给薅没了。在这个只有你能收我高价，不能让我变透明的行业里，AI显然成了影响利润的‘非法入侵者’。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Airlines aren't protecting your privacy; they're protecting their ability to obscure dynamic pricing and kill off cheap fare-hacking bots. In an industry built on obfuscation, a smart AI that actually finds the best deal is the ultimate 'illegal intruder'.

headlines.title_zh: 硅谷政商豪赌失算，腹背受敌
headlines.title_en: Silicon Valley's herd mentality in cozying up to Trump backfired as Democrats may seek retribution, China closes the AI gap, and anti-Big Tech sentiment grows (Nick Clegg/The Atlantic)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 硅谷大佬因押注特朗普导致民主党反噬，叠加中国AI技术追赶与反垄断声浪，陷入前所未有的战略困境
headlines.event_summary_en: Silicon Valley elites face potential retribution from Democrats after aligning with Trump. Meanwhile, they are grappling with China's rapid AI progress and rising domestic anti-Big Tech sentiment, creating a perfect storm for the tech industry.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】硅谷科技领袖、特朗普、民主党派、中国AI产业在美国政治与科技产业决策层：因政治投机行为导致战略受挫，面临政策报复与外部竞争压力
【起因与机理】科技圈内部的羊群效应与错误的政治押注引发了严重的连锁反应
【关键技术规格】硅谷大佬政治押注失效引发政坛反噬。
【观点态度】行业扩张策略陷入多重内忧外患。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Silicon Valley leaders, Trump, Democratic Party, China AI sector: Facing potential backlash and strategic setbacks due to failed political maneuvering
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Herd mentality led to a strategic miscalculation in political alignment
[Key Specification] Silicon Valley's political bet backfired.
[Perspective & Impact] Expansion strategies are compromised by multifaceted threats.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 硅谷大佬们这波操作完美诠释了什么叫“两头没捞着”，既没在白宫换来红利，还把华盛顿的另一半人彻底得罪死了。把AI当成科技军备竞赛的筹码不够，还要在政治博弈里玩火，这届巨头的政治智商确实和他们的算法水平不在一个维度。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Silicon Valley elites are playing a masterclass in how to lose both ways: they bet on the wrong horse and alienated the other half of D.C. It’s almost impressive how their political IQ manages to be so much lower than their LLM benchmarks.

headlines.title_en: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code verified Signal's cryptographic core in four weeks instead of years
headlines.event_summary_zh: DeepMind开发的AlphaProof Code系统仅用四周完成了Signal核心加密协议的审计，工作效率较人工提升数年
headlines.event_summary_en: DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an AI system that automates software security verification. Leveraging Gemini-based agents to write millions of lines of code, the system audited Signal’s encryption protocol in just four weeks—a process that typically takes years.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Google DeepMind、Signal安全团队在软件工程与网络安全防御领域：通过AlphaProof Code实现加密核心代码的数学形式化验证，大幅提升审计效率
【起因与机理】为应对日益复杂的AI攻击威胁，寻求更高效的安全防线
【关键技术规格】AI自动化审计加密协议效率飞跃。
【观点态度】未来有望应用于电网与医疗设施安全。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Google DeepMind, Signal security team: Verified cryptographic code using AlphaProof, significantly boosting audit efficiency
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To establish more robust defenses against growing AI-driven threats
[Perspective & Impact] Future application in critical infrastructure.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 以后程序员最恐怖的梦境不再是“代码跑不动”，而是“AlphaProof四小时把我的屎山代码逻辑全审了一遍”。这技术一旦铺开，以后写Bug的门槛都高了，毕竟AI不仅能帮你写，还能冷酷无情地证明你写的代码到底有多烂。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The new nightmare for devs isn't just broken code—it's having an AI dissect your entire legacy codebase in a lunch break. Once this goes mainstream, the bar for writing bad code is going to get significantly higher, as AI won't just generate your work, it'll mathematically prove how terrible it is.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
